description: Refinance break-even month and lifetime savings of refinancing a loan. Use when the user already has a loan and is weighing a refinance offer; it returns the break-even month and lifetime savings. For a brand-new loan payment use calculate_loan or calculate_mortgage. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive refinance calculator.
